name: Haus Erhart
beschreibung:
Perched on the sunny plateau of Goetzens, Haus Erhart offers cosy rooms and friendly personal hospitality. It serves as an ideal base for mountain hikes and city visits.

The cable car to Muttereralm, walking trails, and the city of Innsbruck are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Erhart in Goetzens provides peaceful relaxation and scenic panoramas near Innsbruck.
